name: Elastoma

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical and Histopathological Diagnostic Criteria for Elastoma

criteria.description: Presence of asymptomatic, yellowish to skin-colored papules or plaques typically located on the trunk or limbs
Histological demonstration of increased and fragmented elastic fibers in the dermis with normal collagen fibers
Optional imaging to exclude associated connective tissue abnormalities

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of characteristic clinical lesions plus confirmatory histopathological findings
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is primarily clinical supported by histopathology; genetic testing is not routinely available.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Yellowish papular or plaque-like skin lesions with increased elastic fibers
searchTerms: papules or plaques with elastic fiber buildup
yellow skin lesions with thickened fibers

pathognomonic.symptomName: Asymptomatic elastic tissue hamartomas localized to the dermis

common.symptomName: Skin thickening and induration over affected areas
Localized skin laxity adjacent to lesions
searchTerms: skin laxity adjacent to affected area

common.symptomName: Presence of multiple discrete papules coalescing into plaques

searchTerms: darkening of skin in affected areas

occasional.symptomName: Mild tenderness on palpation of lesions
Associated connective tissue abnormalities such as joint hypermobility
searchTerms: loose joints associated with skin findings

rare.symptomName: Systemic elastic tissue involvement with cardiovascular manifestations
searchTerms: heart and vessel involvement from tissue defects
systemic connective tissue issues affecting cardiovascular system

rare.symptomName: Ophthalmological abnormalities such as ectopia lentis
Respiratory complications due to elastic tissue defects
searchTerms: lung complications due to elastic fiber issues
respiratory difficulties related to connective tissue

imaging: Skin ultrasound may show dermal thickening
MRI to exclude systemic connective tissue involvement
genetic: No specific genetic mutation identified; sporadic cases predominating
other: Histopathology showing increased, fragmented elastic fibers in dermis

distinguishingFeatures: Localized elastic fiber proliferation without systemic involvement

redFlags: Systemic symptoms such as cardiovascular or respiratory compromise
references: Clinical and Histopathological Features of Elastoma, Journal of Dermatological Science, 2022
